Name: HymnOfReturn
Effect: Returns the cycle to the first dawn, keeping masks, songs, echoes and hearts. Played backwards it slows time to a crawl; played briskly it skips to the next dawn or dusk.

Name: HymnOfMending
Effect: Draws the spirit out of a cursed soul and leaves its face behind as a mask.

Name: MaresCall
Effect: Calls the mare across the fields to wherever you are standing.

Name: SonataOfRousing
Effect: Wakes the temple sleeping under the mire and lifts it into the air.

Name: StoneheartLullaby
Effect: Quiets a raging heart. The mountainfolk sleep through anything while it plays.

Name: TidecallAria
Effect: Summons the tide, and with it the creatures that swim in it.

Name: ElegyOfHollows
Effect: Leaves a hollow statue of your current form standing where you played it, heavy enough to hold a switch.

Name: OathOfConcord
Effect: Calls the four guardians to the tower to hold the moon. Answered only when all four echoes are free.

Name: WindfeatherSong
Effect: Carries you to any owl statue you have already touched.

Name: SongOfStorms
Effect: Calls rain, and with it the springs that only run in bad weather.
